body:
FOR THE ADVISOR, P2-29 part 2 of 2 (PR #103, the drawing S-95; part 1 has what was drawn, question 1 the amendment of PB-38, question 2 the app closed).

3. WHICH JOBS GET A CARD. The owner's own case was an IMPORT (not a pinned Download): ImportsController is separate, its end alert is news (`alertsImports`, off by default, ADR-R44), and D-52 allowed the permission only at the first Download. As the code stands a plain import posts nothing. Recommend: yes, an import gets the running card and its end is part of the SAME card (not a news alert), the once-only permission is asked at the first Import too, and an import and a Download of the playlist it made are ONE line. Also: a single-song download = no card (seconds; "we all hate those"); the import page says "217 songs, 150 saved on your server" while S-16 says "ready on your server": I used S-16's words, the import tile should follow when built.

4. ONE CARD FOR EVERYTHING OR ONE PER DOWNLOAD. Drawn: one for all while running, one result card per job at the end. Recommend that.

5. STOP. None drawn. docs/17 has keep/ask, progress, watch, retry and NO keep-cancel; for a download "stop" today = unpin = deletes the files (too destructive for a shade button). An import has `POST imports/{im}/stop` and a confirm ("Stop this import?"); a card button for it could only open the app on that question. The owner stopped his own import at 24 songs, so a real Stop for a download may be wanted: a new item (server route + the app), not part of this one. The "import stopped elsewhere" frame exists so a card never stays running after another device stops it.

6. PERMISSION: unchanged (D-52: once, first Download, our sentence first). Refused or Android < 13: nothing is posted, nothing breaks, S-16 carries everything (said in captions, no frame). Channel: a new silent LOW "Downloads" channel, NOT `new_music` (the opt-in news channel, category recommendation).

BUILD, when ruled (size M, tests first, fakes only): unit tests of the card's text per stage from the same providers as S-16; a fake LocalNotifications that records show/cancel (nothing posted with the permission refused; the running card refreshed in place, not stacked; `timeoutAfter` set; the downloader's group card configured with no running state, so there is one card); the wording test of the old card goes with it.
